# BhoomiMitra (भू-मित्र) — Direct Land & Plot Marketplace (Full Specification)

> BhoomiMitra is India's direct-to-owner land and agricultural plot classifieds platform, facilitating direct connection between landowners and prospective buyers with 0% brokerage commissions, transparent document disclosure, interactive satellite maps, and a flat advertising fee model.

BhoomiMitra operates a direct peer-to-peer classifieds marketplace covering Indian landowners, agricultural buyers, residential plot buyers, and commercial land investors across all 28 states and 8 union territories (including Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, and Gujarat).

Core Value Propositions: 0% Broker Commission, Direct landowner listings, Transparent seller-provided document disclosure, Direct Phone contact with registered sellers, and Interactive Google Satellite property boundary viewing.

Indian Land Measurement Conversions:
- 1 Square Yard = 1 sq. yd (9 sq. ft)
- 1 Gunta = 121 sq. yds
- 1 Cent = 48.4 sq. yds
- 1 Acre = 4,840 sq. yds (40 Guntas / 100 Cents)
- 1 Hectare = 11,959.9 sq. yds (2.471 Acres)
- 1 Bigha (Standard) = 1,600 to 3,025 sq. yds (region-dependent)

## Key Public Routes

- [Marketplace Homepage](https://bhoomimitra.com/): Marketplace homepage with multi-attribute search and featured land classifieds.
- [Buy Properties](https://bhoomimitra.com/buy): Interactive land explorer with price sliders, unit conversions, and location filters.
- [Sell Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/sell): Multi-step land listing creator with seller legal declarations and instant publishing upon payment.
- [Pricing](https://bhoomimitra.com/pricing): Platform advertising pricing (Flat ₹10-₹25 for 30-day listing subscriptions).
- [About BhoomiMitra](https://bhoomimitra.com/about): BhoomiMitra mission, transparency policies, and zero-brokerage classifieds model.
- [Customer Support](https://bhoomimitra.com/contact): Customer support desk and listing grievance redressal team.
- [Listing Rules](https://bhoomimitra.com/listing-rules): Standards for seller submissions, legal declarations, and prohibited listings.
- [Terms of Service](https://bhoomimitra.com/terms): Platform user terms, listing conditions, and liability disclaimers.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bhoomimitra.com/privacy): Data security, private document vault protection, and cookie rules.

## Core Features & Tools

- [Land Area Converter](https://bhoomimitra.com/#converter): Live Indian land unit converter across Guntas, Cents, Acres, Sq. Yards, and Hectares.
- [Buyer Due Diligence](https://bhoomimitra.com/listing-rules): Checklist for inspecting 30-year deed chains, EC Form 15, and survey sketches.
